_renamed: Sample 1 became Porch & Party Studio on 22 Oct 2026 (owner's word). The slug, Worker, D1 and R2 keep their sample1 names: renaming them would orphan the data (README "Rename a studio").
_ownerEmail: Never in this file (public repo). Set at deploy time from the 0600 file <secrets dir>/sample1/OWNER_EMAIL by `npm run studio:secrets sample1` (README "Owner email"). No first-login link is needed.

photoPosts._why: Photo posts (shared/photoPosts.ts): one photo becomes a pack of posts that go out on their own with a heads-up and a Skip. On by the host's word, 22 Oct 2026.

contentRules._why: Porch & Party's rules, enforced in code (shared/contentRules.ts): never the word insured, no customer address, house number or face, prices only from this one list. Host's word, 22 Oct 2026.

whatsNew.title: New in your studio
lines: Add a photo and the studio makes a few posts from it.
Posts go to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest on their own.
You get an email the day before. Tap Skip to stop one.
Faces and house numbers are blurred before anything posts.
